note: AppleSkin 2.5.2 injected its tooltip lines with a mixin on ItemStack.getTooltip(PlayerEntity,TooltipType); 1.21.1 replaced that method, so the conversion dropped the mixin entry. Re-register the mod's own TooltipOverlayHandler through Fabric's current ItemTooltipCallback instead of re-enabling a mixin that cannot apply.

bodyRedirects.name: init
bodyRedirects.evidence: With the mixin gone, hovering a golden apple showed only the vanilla name (runs/p101-appleskin-hover/). The bridge keeps the mod handler and forwards Fabric's callback to onItemTooltip.
